purpose: Maps each generation stage to the instruction document that drives it. Consumed by the instruction loader to resolve, digest, and stamp the instruction-set revision.
digest_note: This manifest is deliberately NOT part of the instruction-set revision digest. Only the five stage documents participate, so that editing this file (for example adding a comment or reordering keys) does not change the revision recorded against generated artifacts. See specs/011-llm-generation-nodes/contracts/instruction-document.md section 2.
document_format: Exactly four level-2 sections in this order: '## Technology contract', '## Rules', '## Output contract', '## Prohibitions'. The loader depends on this shape.
